name: Onikirimaru
source:
Neon's partner, an Oni Child-type guardian.

Her ability is "Spiritual Stability". Just being around her, everything feels calmer, no matter the situation or circumstances, her master will be able to keep calm and analyse everything objectively. Being able to control electricity, in battle she's capable of a myriad of attack forms and is able to even cause lightnings.
